[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] T5 Data Centers has operated since 2008 per its own site. This specific facility level reading supplements an earlier operator level pass already on file for this operator. This specific row was originally recorded in this registry under the operator T5 Data Centers, based on its own facility name, T5 Data Center, in Alpharetta, Georgia. A facility specific aggregator page on baxtel.com, fetched fresh this session while researching this rows address, surfaced a significant ownership update not reflected in this rows prior operator level research: Stack Infrastructure acquired this Alpharetta facility from T5 in 2019, per that pages own text, which states the facility was constructed in 2012 after the Fulton County Development Authority issued 160 million dollars in taxable bonds, and that T5 Data Centers established its first metro Atlanta facility at this Alpharetta site in 2011. This is consistent with, and specifically narrower than, this registrys separate prior finding that T5 was named alongside Infomart Data Centers as one of two asset sources IPI Partners drew on when forming STACK Infrastructure in 2019: that earlier finding concerned company level asset sourcing, while this new source confirms the specific building level transaction for this exact facility. No STACK Infrastructure row for an Alpharetta or metro Atlanta facility already exists elsewhere in this registry, so rather than flag a possible duplicate, this session corrected this rows own operator field directly from T5 Data Centers to Stack Infrastructure, the current operator per this new source, while preserving T5 Data Centers as former_operator per this registrys no-deletion policy, with ownership_verified_on set to the date of this research. The same baxtel.com page also gives 3200 Webb Bridge Road as the street address, which this session applied given it comes from the same page confirming the ownership change and building history.

reading.body:
T5 Data Center in Alpharetta is operated by Stack Infrastructure following the company's 2019 acquisition from T5 Data Centers. The facility was constructed in 2012 using proceeds from Fulton County Development Authority bonds and established T5's first metro Atlanta presence. Current operator, address, and ownership succession are verified.

Published specifications for this campus are not included in the data provided. Without IT load, total power allocation, or rack count from Stack Infrastructure's spec page, translation into accelerator density or training capacity cannot be performed.

Georgia has 33 mapped data center facilities and 66.3 megawatts of published capacity across four sites with disclosed power figures. T5 Alpharetta ranks fifth among published facilities in the state, indicating it either publishes no power specification or does not appear in the four disclosed figures. Its position in state ranking cannot be interpreted without access to the operator's published specifications.
